title: The full test run passes every time, not one run in two
goal: Three video and title tests fail at random when the whole test suite runs and pass when run on their own, so a loop task can be refused its commit by a test that has nothing to do with its change. Make them hold up under the full run's load.
notes: Seen 2026-10-13 by the runner on size-mode-measures-real-buttons-and-objects-not, four full runs of `Scripts/test.sh` on a quiet machine (no process over 50% CPU), code unrelated to these tests: run 1 failed 3 issues; run 2 failed `TitleSetFramesTests.swift:214` (median 17.72 ms vs < 16) and `GrainBandingExportTests.swift:106` ((grainy * 3 → 93) <= (plain * 2 → 88)); run 3 failed `VideoCutExportTests.swift:69` (.readerGaveUp("no picture came out of the recording for 30 seconds")); run 4 passed all 12871. `Scripts/test.sh --filter "VideoCutExportTests|TitleSetFramesTests|GrainBandingExportTests"` passed 10/10 alone each time. The title-frame one is a wall-clock budget, not a ratio against a ruler like the PerfClock/CPUYardstick checks.
acceptance: Four full runs of Scripts/test.sh in a row on an otherwise quiet machine pass with no failures
The title-frame time check, the grain banding check and the cut export check still fail when what they guard really regresses (say how this was shown)
Nothing is skipped or loosened without a comment saying what was measured

log.note: also seen 2026-10-13 by dragging-a-magnify-lens-never-smears-or-corrupts, two full runs both failed the same 3 wall-clock 16ms budgets: TextDepthPerspectiveTests.swift:170 (median 28.07ms), MotionBlurRenderTests.swift:212 (16.72ms), DepthTransitionRenderTests.swift:138 (17.23ms). Alone (--filter 'DepthTransitionRender') they passed 3 of 3 with and without that task's renderer change, medians 5-12ms.

also flaked 2026-10-13 under the full run: Space3DPerfTests.swift:118 '1080p, ten layers, four tilted and one out of focus: a frame in under 16ms' median 26.04ms (load average 6.9); alone (Scripts/test.sh --filter Space3DPerf) median 5.0ms, passed. Seen while landing resizing-a-zoom-callout-keeps-its-shape-by-defau, whose change does not touch that test's layers (no callouts).

and the next full run (2026-10-13 05:27) failed TextDepthPerspectiveTests.swift:170 'a headline flipping up by letter, motion blur on: a frame in under 16ms' at median 16.42ms; the 16ms perf gates are the flaky ones under the parallel suite.
